text:
Changed packages/auth/src/platform/handshake.ts and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/metastate-handoff-handshake-ttl.md.

Commit message:
Brightwater Civic's deployments sign the challenge in an HSM that waits for an operator's approval, up to four minutes in office hours; at two minutes about half their handshakes expired.

writes.docs/decisions/metastate-handoff-handsha:
# Why packages/auth/src/platform/handshake.ts holds this value

Brightwater Civic's deployments sign the challenge in an HSM that waits for an operator's approval, up to four minutes in office hours; at two minutes about half their handshakes expired.
